```{r}
library(BayesSpace)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggspavis)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(scrapper)
library(SpatialExperiment)
```

#Data loading
```{r}
spe <- load('Breast_ST5.RData')
```

#Preliminary data exploration

Number of genes and rows
```{r}
dim(speBreast)
```
Which are the names of the assays?

```{r}
assayNames(speBreast)
```
Which gene ID is used in the assay?

```{r}
speBreast@rowRanges
```
What other type of additional information can be retrieved about the genes?
```{r}
head(rowData(speBreast))
```
What other type of additional information can be retrieved about the spots?
```{r}
colData(speBreast)
```

Which is the max and the min of the spatial coordinates?

```{r}
head(spatialCoords(speBreast))
coordinates <- spatialCoords(speBreast)
c(max(coordinates),min(coordinates))
range(coordinates)
```

#Visualize data

Plotting the spatial coordinates and with the annotation
```{r}
plotCoords(speBreast, point_size = 5)
plotCoords(speBreast, point_size = 5, annotate = 'annotation')
```
Highliting one specific spot
```{r}
coords <- as.data.frame(coordinates)
min_y_coord <- coords$pxl_row_in_fullres == min(coords$pxl_row_in_fullres)
min_x_coords <- coords$pxl_col_in_fullres == min(coords$pxl_col_in_fullres[min_y_coord])

top_left <- rownames(coords)[which(min_x_coords & min_y_coord)]
colData(speBreast)[, 'Top_Left'] <- as.character(colnames(speBreast) == top_left)

plotCoords(speBreast, annotate = "Top_Left", point_size = 5, pal = c('grey','red'))
```

Plotting the expression values for the VAMP7 gene.
Highlight which are the sports with the max value of VAMP7 expression.
```{r}
vamp7 <- rownames(speBreast)[rowData(speBreast)$symbol == 'VAMP7'] 
plotCoords(speBreast, annotate = vamp7, point_size = 5) + ggtitle("VAMP7")

#Maximum expression

colData(speBreast)[, "maxVAMP7"] <- as.character(assay(speBreast)[vamp7,] == max(assay(speBreast)[vamp7,]))
plotCoords(speBreast, annotate = "maxVAMP7", point_size = 5, pal = c("grey","red"))
```
#Quality Control

Violin plot of the QC metrics and scatterplot of QC metrics together
```{r}
speBreast <- speBreast[, speBreast$in_tissue == 1]
dim(speBreast)
```
